description: This file defines the ShapeMetadata class used for managing shape metadata, caching, and event handling within OrchardCore's display management system.

classes.name: ShapeMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata for a shape, including caching, display events, and shape properties.

methods.name: OnDisplaying
methods.description: Registers an action to be invoked when the shape is displaying.

methods.name: OnProcessing
methods.description: Registers a function to process the shape asynchronously.

methods.name: OnDisplayed
methods.description: Registers an action to be invoked after the shape has been displayed.

methods.name: Cache
methods.description: Marks the shape to be cached with a specific cache ID.

methods.name: Cache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache context if the shape is cached.
